title: Crispi Stuffed Cremini Caps
description: Ricotta mushroom caps sized for two and finished just before serving.
equipment: Ninja Crispi, 4-qt glass container and adapter

steps.title: Prepare the vegetables
steps.text: Remove the stems from large cremini mushrooms and finely chop them. Use {mush}.

steps.title: Prepare the center
steps.text: Cook the chopped stems in a dry skillet for 4 minutes until the liquid evaporates.

steps.title: Stuff the caps
steps.text: Mix the cooked stems with {ricotta}, {parm} and {parsley}. Spoon into the caps and flatten the tops.

steps.title: Roast the vegetables
steps.text: Brush with {oil}. Place in one layer on the crisper plate in the 4-qt glass container. Fit the adapter and PowerPod and select Air Fry. Cook 11–16 minutes in the Crispi until soft inside and lightly browned on top.

notes: Make ahead: prepare the topping a day ahead. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: No. The high-water vegetables soften after thawing. Freeze only if texture is secondary. Fridge reheat: warm covered to 165°F; add the topping last. Freezer reheat: thaw in the fridge before warming covered. Use unsalted plant butter or dairy-free cheese where needed. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 123 kcal, 9.6 g protein, 6.8 g total carbohydrate, 7.3 g fat, 1.3 g fiber, 150 mg sodium.
